notes.title: Buttons layout and some QoL changes
notes.notes:
V2.1 Changelog:
- Added Language selection when you first run the game (you can change it later in the options menu)
- Changed character running animation and his color palette
- Changed ending: Now you can read at your pace and change to next dialogue when you are ready
- Added diferent buttons layouts for joysticks and an alt layout for keyboard

notes.title: Added some QoL changes:
notes.notes:
V1.9
- Added turn while ducking
- Added Name of the button to activate potion in the UI
- Change UI buttons on real time when joystick is enable/disable
- Changed how the story is displayed, now you can read at your pace and go to next dialogue when pressing a button instead automaticly.
- Some changes in Options menu were made

notes.title: Fixed a strange bug and added more QoL changes
notes.notes:
- Fixed the bug where after defeating the third boss the end of level portal was not visible.
- Added some red particles to background elements that are enemies, like cactus in Area 2
- Area 3 Fox speed changed
